name: smeltr_rows_polled_total
what: Records the source returned.

name: smeltr_bytes_polled_total
what: Bytes of those records.

name: smeltr_tick_poll_seconds_total
what: Seconds spent waiting on the source for records.

name: smeltr_tick_idle_polls_total
what: Polls that returned no records.

name: smeltr_commits_total
what: Offset commits the source accepted.

name: smeltr_commits_dropped_total
what: Offset commits that failed and were let go. The next commit covers their records.

name: smeltr_source_in_flight
what: Batches read and not yet committed.

name: smeltr_source_lag
what: What the source has yet to finish. Kafka: records in the partition past the group's committed offset. SQS and Azure Storage Queue: messages on the queue, held ones included, as partition 0 of a topic named for the queue.

name: smeltr_source_messages_finished_total
what: Queue messages the source finished with: every object they named read and committed. A queue's lag drains at this rate.

name: smeltr_source_blocked
what: 1 while the source is stopped on a record it may not pass: an exception or refusal answered `block`, or nothing could process or deliver the record. 0 once it reads again.

name: smeltr_source_dropped_total
what: Records the source let go because it had no room for them. A syslog receiver over UDP counts each datagram that arrives while it is full or blocked.

name: smeltr_source_full_total
what: Times a receiver had no memory left for what a sender offered: a request it answered busy, or a connection it stopped reading. Its memory, not its sender, set the pace.

name: smeltr_source_poll_failures_total
what: Reads of the source that failed. The source is read again after a wait, and what it has not delivered stays uncommitted there.

name: smeltr_source_refused_total
what: Requests a receiver refused, by reason: token, unreadable, too_large, unsupported, late, busy or other.

name: smeltr_tick_batches_total
what: Batches run through routes and pipelines.

name: smeltr_tick_process_seconds_total
what: Seconds spent running those batches.

name: smeltr_tick_flush_seconds_total
what: Seconds spent handing processed batches to destinations.

name: smeltr_batches_waiting_for_room_total
what: Hand-offs that waited because a destination's queue was full.

name: smeltr_batches_poisoned_total
what: Batches a pipeline could not finish because it crashed on them.

name: smeltr_batches_dlq_total
what: Batches no pipeline could process, sent whole to a dead-letter destination.

name: smeltr_route_matched_total
what: Records the route's condition matched.

name: smeltr_rows_unmatched_total
what: Records that met Unmatched. `cause` is `route` (no route matched) or `rule` (no delivery rule of its route took it).

name: smeltr_rows_dropped_total
what: Records let go. `reason` is `unmatched` (Unmatched answered drop), `exception` (an exception answered drop), `unprocessable` (no pipeline could process it) or `rejected` (a destination refused it for good).

name: smeltr_rows_dlq_over_budget_total
what: Records sent to a dead-letter destination because one alone does not fit the memory budget.

name: smeltr_function_calls_total
what: Instructions the step ran. A step can compile to several, and one inside a loop counts on every pass.

name: smeltr_function_seconds_total
what: Seconds the step ran. A step inside a loop is not timed: its time goes to the loop step.

name: smeltr_rows_dropped_total
what: Records the step removed.

name: smeltr_rows_errored_total
what: Records the step gave an exception, by its kind.

name: smeltr_rows_in_total
what: Records in each batch that reached a loop step, whether its condition holds for them or not.

name: smeltr_rows_out_total
what: Records the loop step's condition let in.

name: smeltr_rows_sent_total
what: Records handed to the destination.

name: smeltr_rows_without_doc_id_total
what: Records sent to a `dedupe` or `overwrite` destination with no document ID.

name: smeltr_rows_send_failed_total
what: Records in a hand-over that failed. They are sent again.

name: smeltr_flushes_total
what: Hand-overs the destination finished.

name: smeltr_rows_delivered_total
what: Records in batches the destination acknowledged, including records it refused within them.

name: smeltr_bytes_delivered_total
what: Bytes of those records.

name: smeltr_rows_rejected_total
what: Records the destination refused for good.

name: smeltr_rows_salvaged_total
what: Refused records a dead-letter destination took.

name: smeltr_rows_lost_total
what: Refused records with nowhere left to go.

name: smeltr_destination_healthy
what: 1 while the destination takes writes, 0 after a failed send.

name: smeltr_destination_stalls_total
what: Failed sends that marked the destination unhealthy.

name: smeltr_destination_in_flight
what: Requests the destination may have open at once.

name: smeltr_destination_held_rows
what: Rows the destination refused and keeps to send again.

name: smeltr_destination_open_bytes
what: Bytes in a destination pending an upload.

name: smeltr_destination_queue_bytes
what: Bytes waiting in the destination's queue.

name: smeltr_destination_pace_headroom_ratio
what: How much room the buffer leaves above what the connection can carry, as a share of the buffer, averaged over the last ten seconds. Staying near 0 means the buffer, not the connection, is holding the destination back. Not reported for a destination that writes files.

name: smeltr_destination_queue_budget_bytes
what: The most bytes the destination's queue holds.

name: smeltr_destination_unwritten_total
what: What the store took but said it did not store as sent, in its own units: a Prometheus remote_write 2.0 store's samples, histograms and exemplars, and documents an Elasticsearch failure store took.

name: smeltr_destination_throttled_seconds_total
what: Seconds the destination was held back because it was asked to slow down: by its brokers for Kafka, and in the backoff after a throttled answer for an HTTP destination (Elasticsearch, Splunk HEC, HTTP, Prometheus). Summed over concurrent requests.

name: smeltr_destination_buffered_bytes
what: Bytes waiting inside the Kafka client. Kafka only.

name: smeltr_destination_rtt_seconds
what: Mean round trip to the brokers in seconds. Kafka only.

name: smeltr_memory_budget_bytes
what: The worker's memory budget. 0 under `thread=deploy` means none.

name: smeltr_memory_peak_bytes
what: The most memory the worker's threads have held at once. Present only with a memory budget.

name: smeltr_memory_splits_total
what: Batches split in half to fit the memory budget.

name: smeltr_memory_abandoned_seconds_total
what: Seconds spent on attempts given up for memory.

name: smeltr_destination_pool_bytes
what: Bytes the destination queues sized to the worker's memory have borrowed above their reserves. At smeltr_destination_pool_budget_bytes, memory is what holds them back.

name: smeltr_destination_pool_budget_bytes
what: The most the destination queues sized to the worker's memory may borrow above their reserves, together.

name: smeltr_receiver_pool_bytes
what: Bytes the receivers sized to the worker's memory have borrowed from the pool they share. At smeltr_receiver_pool_budget_bytes, memory is what holds them back.

name: smeltr_memory_allocated_bytes
what: Bytes the worker's runtime has allocated and not freed. What its resident memory holds above this is what the allocator keeps of what was freed, and what C libraries allocate themselves.

name: smeltr_receiver_pool_budget_bytes
what: The most the receivers sized to the worker's memory may borrow above their reserves, together.

name: smeltr_memory_part_bytes
what: The most one part of the deployment may hold, one sample per part: what `part` names, under the source or destination it belongs to when it belongs to one. Together they are what the worker's memory must fit.

name: smeltr_source_held_bytes
what: Bytes a source holds that its reader has not taken.

name: smeltr_source_lane_bytes
what: Bytes waiting between a source's reader and transform.

name: smeltr_process_memory_bytes
what: Bytes of memory a worker process holds: the supervisor's or the runtime's.

name: smeltr_worker_threads_budget
what: The most threads the deployment may use.

name: smeltr_worker_slice_bytes
what: The raw bytes of a batch a transform thread runs at once, sized to the CPU's cache.

name: smeltr_worker_readers
what: Reader threads, one per source.

name: smeltr_worker_transform_threads
what: Threads running pipelines.

name: smeltr_worker_egress_threads
what: Threads sending to destinations.

name: smeltr_capture_records_total
what: Records a sample capture read. Its `source` label holds the source's name.

name: smeltr_logs_written_total
what: Log events written since the process started, by the `site` that wrote them.

name: smeltr_logs_dropped_total
what: Log events dropped for want of room since the process started.

name: smeltr_logs_unread_total
what: Log events a full logs reader's queue refused since the process started, one count per reader.

name: smeltr_logs_undelivered_total
what: Log events refused while the leader was out of contact, since the process started.

name: smeltr_logs_unwritable_total
what: Log events the console would not take since the process started.
